faces.transcription: Find card 80 in the Operations deck and place it in the Intelligence file. Anyone can look at it at any time.
faces.flavor: The team was too late. Dozens of civilians witnessed a messy execution in broad daylight. After a lot of effort, your team cooled the ire of local authorities and claimed what was left of the body. During examination, a document was found in a hidden compartment in the Soviet agent's billfold.
